title: Stray Kids
author: Angie
description: Una recopilación de una banda surcoreana llamada Stray Kids

extraits.texte: My bias is jeongin (I.N, FoxI.Ny) and we’re definitely married. Don’t look into any files though….just trust me. ;) My favorite SKZ song is Freeze and my fav albums are Oddinary (1st), Karma (2nd), and NOISY (3rd). I don’t understand Spanish, but SKZ rules!!!

extraits.titre: Can we make this in English?
extraits.texte: I tried to listen to this but it was all a different language and I speak 4 languages!!!! So I’m not sure if it’s a bad thing or I’m just a Karen…
I did not understand a single word that was said but it was okay… anyways Felix and Bangchan r my bias I had 20 kids with them both ❤️ love you all ❤️ 🐥🐺
